Best Areas to Buy Property in Phuket

A buyer’s comparison of the main areas
HomeGuidesBest Areas to Buy Property in Phuket

Choose your area · Last reviewed: 2026-11-23

There is no single best area. The right one depends on whether you want to live there, rent the unit out, or buy for the long term. Here are the main areas where we list projects, with what each is known for. For current projects and prices, open the linked location page.

South: Rawai, Nai Harn and Chalong

The south has a settled, residential feel with a larger year-round community. Nai Harn has a well-known beach and lake and Rawai has a local seafront with restaurants. It suits buyers who plan to live in Phuket.

Kata and Karon

These are busy west-coast beach towns with plenty of restaurants, shops and visitor traffic. Buyers often consider them for holiday use and rental potential, though rental income is never guaranteed.

Kamala and Patong

Kamala is a smaller, quieter west-coast area with a mix of hillside and beach projects. Patong is the island’s busiest nightlife and tourism centre, which brings convenience and noise in equal measure.

Bang Tao, Cherng Talay and Laguna

The north-west is known for the Laguna resort cluster, Bang Tao beach, international schools and larger villa and condo developments. It suits families and buyers who want a resort-style setting.

Nai Yang and Mai Khao

Near the airport and the national park, with long quiet beaches and a lower density of development. It suits buyers who want space and easy airport access.

How to choose

  • Decide your use: living, holiday, rental or long-term hold.
  • Visit at different times of year; the monsoon season changes beaches and traffic.
  • Check distances: beach, hospital, supermarket and school are listed under Nearby on each project page.
  • Compare the ownership type and the payment plan, not only the price.

Frequently asked questions

Which area is best for rental income?

No area guarantees income. Rental depends on building rules, season, price and management. Check the rules of the specific building.

Which area is closest to the airport?

Nai Yang and Mai Khao are the closest of the areas we list.

General information only, not legal or tax advice, and rules can change. Confirm every point with a licensed Thai lawyer and the Land Department before you pay a deposit.
